VSEOCLASS.DESCRIPT: Print Driver: Base Provider Class (SmartF + Adobe)

TLINE.TDLINE: &FUNCTIONALITY&
The /CTDI/CL_PRINT_DRIVER_BASE class is the central base class for all
print driver subclasses in the dynamic printing framework. It
implements the template method execution flow to decouple the core
processing lifecycle from subclass-specific data logic.
EXECUTION FLOW
The main execution is driven by the final method "execute", which
performs the following sequential action hooks:
1. unpack_io_data: Extract and unpack parameters.
2. fetch_data_from_db: Retrieve required data from the database.
3. map_and_register_data: Map fields and register parameters.
4. call_form: Resolve technology and render form layout.
HOW TO EXTEND
To implement a new print driver class:
1. Create a subclass inheriting from /CTDI/CL_PRINT_DRIVER_BASE.
2. Redefine and implement the protected hook methods:
- unpack_io_data
- fetch_data_from_db
- map_and_register_data
3. Inside map_and_register_data, register custom parameters using
method register_custom_parameter, passing the explicit kind (e.g.,
abap_func_exporting, abap_func_tables) to avoid runtime DB lookups.
